name: PostgreSQL
description: Query any PostgreSQL database, inspect schemas, explain plans and get index/health recommendations (Postgres MCP Pro by Crystal DBA).

settings.label: Read-only (restricted mode)
settings.help: Restricted mode runs read-only transactions with execution time limits. Turn off for full read/write access (development databases only).

secrets.label: Connection URI
secrets.help: postgresql://username:password@host:5432/dbname. Use a read-only database role for production.
